# Kuchu Puchu

> Kuchu Puchu is a free kids video app and website (https://mykuchupuchu.com) with short, funny educational videos for children aged 3 to 8. Kids learn ABCs and phonics, counting and numbers, colors and shapes, the names of animals and things, nursery rhymes and poems, moral stories and good habits. There are no ads, no comments and no sign-up for kids.

## For parents

- Age: made only for children aged 3 to 8 (preschool, kindergarten and early school years).
- Price: free. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads.
- Safety: every creator is approved by the Kuchu Puchu team and videos are reviewed before they go live. No violence, scary or adult content, bad language, ads or product promotion. Comments are off. Parents can report any video.
- Privacy: no advertising IDs, no tracking tools, no third-party analytics. Kids watch without an account.
- Languages: videos in Hindi, English, Punjabi, Haryanvi, Urdu and more; a grown-up can choose which languages to show.
- Topics: cartoons, rhymes and songs, stories and fairy tales, early learning (letters, numbers, colors, shapes, first words), animals, arts and crafts, good habits and feelings, our world, learning languages.

## The app

- The Kuchu Puchu app for Android and iPhone is coming soon to the app stores.
- Until then, Android users can install it from the APK file: https://mykuchupuchu.com/downloads/my-kuchu-puchu.apk
- The website also plays every video free: https://mykuchupuchu.com

## For creators

Independent creators make the videos. Creators apply, are approved by the team, upload original short kids videos, and can earn money from qualified views and approved original uploads, paid to a bank account or PayPal.
